definitions.explanation: the latter part of autumn, typically from late October to November

examples.japanese: {晩秋|ばんしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{紅葉|こうよう}→紅葉：04151_kouyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The autumn leaves in late fall are beautiful.

examples.japanese: {晩秋|ばんしゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{朝晩|あさばん}→朝晩：28955_asaban⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{冷|ひ}え{込|こ}む→冷え込む：11727_hiekomu⟧。
examples.english: In late autumn, mornings and evenings get cold.

examples.japanese: {晩秋|ばんしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{候|こう}、⟦いかが→いかが：02846_ikaga⟧お⟦{過|す}ごし→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧でしょう⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How are you doing in these late autumn days? (formal letter)

notes:
USAGE:
The last part of autumn, roughly late October through November, when the leaves turn and fall and the nights grow cold. Mostly written; {晩秋|ばんしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{候|こう} is a standard seasonal opening in formal letters of this period.
